scope: Offline Pythonic source extensions; native/compiler equivalence not established

dynamic_select.order: Validate selector once, then all labels once in clause/list order before first-match selection
dynamic_select.typing: BOOLEAN, ASCII STRING and finite numeric categories stay separate; no aggregate/resource labels
dynamic_select.lifetime: Suspended label calls retain selector/prior labels; GOTO body entry bypasses dispatch; ordinary effects, counter guards and cleanup
dynamic_select.reports: Constant slots keep values; dynamic slots null plus source/type metadata; explicit eager policy

numeric_transfers.conversions: GET_VAR/SET_VAR scalars and same-rank prefixes: integral family and integral-to-REAL
numeric_transfers.validation: Source domain then receiver bounds, missing markers and SHORT sentinel; unknown BYTE cannot be promoted
numeric_transfers.atomicity: Complete prepared prefix before data/cache entry/status publication; stable receiver identity and retained tails
numeric_transfers.boundary: No REAL-to-integral, BOOLEAN/numeric, rank or positional representation coercion

xml_records.roots: Explicit user STRUCTURE, VECTOR, CONFIG, XYZWPR, XYZWPREXT and POSITION
xml_records.validation: Existing static paths, scalar conversions, staging, duplicate/overlap guards, CONFIG limits and recursive POSITION protection
xml_records.boundary: No scalar/whole ARRAY/joint/resource root, implicit pose orientation, XML writing or schema discovery

strict_mode: Future milestone; preserve legacy INTEGER constant SELECT guards
